title: Continuous-variable approximate unitary 2-design, with applications to unclonable encryption
summary: We introduce an $\varepsilon$-approximate unitary 2-design that is compatible with the structure of p- and q-quadratures in continuous-variable (CV) quantum systems. The design unitaries are defined on a finite-dimensional discretisation of the CV space and can be physically implemented as operations on the full CV space. This establishes the first approximate unitary design for CV systems. The design alternatingly acts with unitaries based on the quadrature operators $\hat q$ and $\hat p$.
